# Cheerful stickers — Style Prompt

> Flat high-key colour fields hard-cut against a dark ground, and everything on them behaves like a die-cut sticker: thick ink outline, paper-white rim, a hard offset shadow, and an entrance that pops past its size and snaps back. A small friendly mascot lives in the frame, a switch flips the whole screen into the brand colour, prices land as tags, numbers count up, and big block words slam in one per beat.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

A **playful feature-drop film**: the grammar of current app and fintech launch ads, made friendly, for a shop's service, a creator's series or a teacher's lesson alike. The screen alternates between **one dark ground** and **one or two saturated flat fields** (a hard brightness switch every scene or two). On top sit **stickers**: UI cards, price tags, chips, speech bubbles, stars and a mascot, all flat, outlined and casting a hard shadow with no blur. Everything enters with **overshoot** (back or elastic), and the type is **giant, uppercase, stacked block lettering** that slams from oversized to size. The tone is cheeky and confident: the subject (a service, a menu, a channel, a lesson) is the hero, the mascot is its sidekick.

Not a cartoon short (the mascot reacts and points, it does not carry a story), not a soft pastel explainer (colour is saturated and flat, contrast is high), not glossy 3D (no gradients, no glow, no depth of field), not a slideshow (every scene has a pop, a count, a tap or a slam within its first 0.5 s, and the camera never stops drifting).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Grounds**: solid fills only. One dark ground (near-black with a hint of hue) and the brand's pop colour as a full-bleed field; a light paper ground for proof and data. No gradients, no textures, no vignettes.
- **The sticker**: paper-white (or flat colour) fill, **ink outline 5–8 px**, corner radius 28–70 px (pills for chips and buttons), **hard offset shadow straight down 12–16 px in ink**, zero blur. Every card, tag, chip, bubble and phone is one.
- **Mascot**: a simple round body (blob, bubble, bun, cup, pencil: one shape that fits the subject) in a light tint, thick ink outline, two tall oval eyes with a white catchlight, blush ovals in the accent, a small open smile. No limbs needed; it can lean, peek, bob and blink. Keep it to ≤ 1/3 of frame height except on the end card. Draw it as real nodes (or clone them), not through `<use>`, so its body and eyes can move.
- **Sparkles**: four-point stars in accent and paper white, ink outlined, in bursts of 5–8 around the object that just landed.
- **UI is drawn, not screenshotted**: a phone is a big rounded sticker with rows, a total and one fat pill button.
- **Supporting shapes**: price tags with a punched hole, speech bubbles, rating stars, tile mosaics of small rounded squares, a toggle switch.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar`: the dark ground for the hook and the "how it works" scenes. Text on it is `--teks` (paper white), the hint lines `--teks-redup`; the one keyword is `--utama` through `--kata-kunci`, which falls back to `--teks` when the brand's main colour would not read on its background.
- `--latar-2`: the dull "off" surface, the toggle track before it switches on.
- `--utama`: the pop, the brand's loudest colour as a full field. It arrives by a switch, a flood or a hard cut; type on it is `--teks-di-utama`. The end card's pill is its inverse: a `--teks-di-utama` fill with `--utama` text.
- `--aksen`: a second saturated colour for the price field, the main button, blush and sparkles. Text on it is `--teks-di-aksen`, which the script sets to `--tinta` or `--kertas`, whichever contrasts more, because a brand's accent can be light or dark.
- Fixed, whatever the brand: `--kertas` (sticker fill and the light proof ground), `--tinta` (outlines, hard shadows and type on paper), `--segar` (a fresh green only for "done" states: a checkmark, a confirmed button), `--maskot` (the mascot's body tint). One ink and one paper for everything, so the stickers read as one set on any field.
- Rule: never more than two saturated colours visible at once; the field and its stickers must contrast (ink type on a light field, paper type on a dark one).

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries the display lines, prices and counters: a heavy grotesk in uppercase (Archivo Black by default; Bebas Neue for condensed lines, Poppins 800 when the brand has neither), tight tracking, leading ~0.98, 2–3 stacked lines, each line 0.06–0.09 of frame height, filling ~85 % of the frame width.
- **Emphasis**: one line per block switches to paper fill with an ink stroke (outline-and-fill letters, 6 px stroke), or to the main colour on dark.
- `--font-isi` carries body and UI text: a geometric sans in 500 and 800 (Poppins), 34–56 px at 1080 wide.
- Sizes at 1080 × 1920: hook 160 px, promise 140 px, scene titles 104 px, the price 150 px, the counter 220 px, the end-card name 128 px, chips 52 px, the CTA pill 60 px. A wider brand face needs these 10–15 % smaller.
- Words reveal **one line per beat** (0.22–0.30 s apart), never letter by letter.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Shot length**: median 1.8 s per scene; the references cut 26 times a minute (median across films), the calmest at 4, the fastest at 65. For a 15 s vertical film: 5–7 scenes of 1.8–3 s, cut hard on a beat (tempo around 125–130 bpm, so a beat ≈ 0.47 s).
- **Entrances** (elements): 0.25–0.5 s. Stickers `back.out(1.6–3)`, toggles and knobs `elastic.out(1, 0.4–0.5)`, display words slam from scale 1.8–2.2 to 1 in 0.26–0.28 s with `circ.out` (the most frequent fitted out-ease after `power1.out`).
- **Exits**: almost none; scenes end on a hard cut. When something must leave, 0.2–0.25 s `power2.in`.
- **Camera drift**: inside a held scene the frame pushes in slowly and **linearly** (`ease: "none"`, the single most common measured camera ease) to 1.03–1.05 over the scene; measured push-ins cluster at 1.02–1.07.
- **Punch-in**: on the payoff (a price landing, a count finishing) a fast push to 1.13–1.17 in ~0.3 s (`circ.out` or `power1.out`; median measured camera move 0.3 s), then settle back.
- **Reveal pull-back**: for scale (a mosaic, a crowd of tiles) pull from close to 0.5–0.77 with `power1.out`.
- **Idle life**: the mascot bobs (`sine.inOut` yoyo, ~0.45 s per half cycle) and blinks once per scene (eyelid 0.07 s). Buttons pulse 1.04–1.06 at the CTA.
- **Counters**: count up in 0.8–1.1 s `power2.out`, then a punch or a sparkle burst on the final value.
- What never happens: soft cross-dissolves, slow fades between scenes, blur.

## 6. Camera grammar

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Hard cut with brightness switch (dark ↔ pop field) | a new beat, energy reset | hook → promise; problem → solution; feature → price |
| Slow linear push-in (1.03–1.05) | attention held on one thing | a phone screen; a product card; a list being filled; a lesson's key line |
| Punch-in (1.13–1.17 in 0.3 s) and settle | "this is the number" | a price; a discount; a counter's final value |
| Colour flood from a tapped control | the subject changes the whole world | turning a service on; "before / after"; a toggle hook |
| Pull-back from one tile to a mosaic (to 0.5–0.77) | one becomes many | customers, orders served, subscribers, students, menu items |
| Mascot peek from the frame edge | a friendly witness | confirming an action; a tip; "I'm here" moments |
| Locked frame, stacked type slam | the message, plainly | a headline promise; a rule to remember; the end card |

## 7. Native moves

- **The switch hook.** A dull grey toggle under a question; the knob springs across, the pill fills, and the colour floods the frame into the next scene. *Fits content like:* a laundry's "Cucian numpuk?" switched on; a cafe turning on "mode pesan antar"; a study creator flipping on "mode fokus"; a kids' story where the hero switches on "mode berani".
- **Block-word slam.** Two or three uppercase lines slam in from double size, one per beat, one line in outline letters. *Fits content like:* "BIAR KAMI YANG CUCI"; "KUE BARU TIAP PAGI"; "3 TRIK EDIT DI HP" for a creator; "PECAHAN DALAM 1 MENIT" for a teacher.
- **Sticker price tag.** A tilted tag with a punched hole pops in, the price counts up, punch-in, sparkles, then benefit chips stick on around it one by one. *Fits content like:* a food stall's "Rp15.000 sudah sama es teh"; a laundry per kilo with "gratis antar-jemput"; a class at "Rp49.000 / bulan" with "rekaman" and "grup diskusi" chips; a creator's preset pack.
- **Tap and confirm.** A drawn phone rises as a sticker, rows stagger in, a ripple on the fat button, the button flips to the success colour with a check. *Fits content like:* ordering through chat; booking a cleaning slot; joining a class; a fan sending a question to a creator's Q&A.
- **Mascot sidekick.** The mascot pops up from below or peeks from the edge with a speech bubble at the moment of confirmation. *Fits content like:* a coffee cup saying "Siap diseduh!"; a bun for a bakery; a pencil for a study channel; a little cloud narrating a bedtime story.
- **Mosaic multiplication.** Small rounded tiles pop from the centre outward to fill the frame behind a counter sticker. *Fits content like:* "1.250+ cucian beres"; "300 porsi terjual hari ini"; "10.000 subscriber"; "2.000 murid sudah ikut".
- **Pulse CTA end card.** Mascot, stacked name slam, an inverse pill button that breathes, a contact line; held still ≥ 2 s to read. *Fits content like:* "Pesan via chat" and a number; "Follow untuk tips besok"; "Daftar kelas" and a link; "Tamat. Sampai cerita berikutnya".

## 8. Pitfalls

- A soft or blurred shadow turns a sticker into glossy UI: the shadow is ink, straight down, zero blur. An animated blur also drops frames in the preview.
- Everything popping at once reads as noise: stagger 0.06–0.3 s, and let one thing land per beat.
- A third saturated colour, or type that does not contrast its field: under another brand use `--teks-di-utama` on the pop, `--teks-di-aksen` on the accent, and ink on paper stickers.
- The mascot taking over: it stays under a third of the frame and reacts; it does not tell the story.
- Letter-by-letter reveals, cross-dissolves or slow fades: lines slam one per beat and scenes end on a hard cut.
- A dead frame: a held scene without the linear drift, a pop or a blink for more than ~0.5 s looks like a slide.
- Block words that overflow: at 140–160 px keep a line to about nine characters, or drop the size for that line; never let it wrap.
- Hundreds of tiles in the mosaic: about 60–70 tiles staggered 0.008 s is the budget; more moving nodes drop frames.
- A sticker's tilt set as a CSS `transform` and then rotated by the timeline: set the tilt on the timeline (`fromTo` to its final angle).

## Measured from the references

- Films: 8 exemplars (cluster of 30).
- Median length: 27.6 s (cluster); exemplars 9–111 s.
- Cuts per minute: median 26 across exemplars (range 4–65); cluster average 8.1.
- Median shot: 1.8 s (range 0.65–4.7 s).
- Tempo: median ~129 bpm (88–164).
- Camera moves: median duration 0.3 s; eases fitted: none/linear 57, power1.out 12, sine.out 9, circ.out 9, power2.out 5, power1.in 5.
- Push-in zoom: typical 1.02–1.07, punch 1.13–1.17, extreme up to 1.7–3.0.
- Pull-back zoom: typical 0.95–0.97 drift, reveals 0.5–0.77.
- Element easing described as snappy in 6 of 8 films.

# Cheerful stickers: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.8, medium 2.4, long 3.

## hook

- en: a grey toggle under an uppercase question; the knob springs across, the pill fills and the main colour floods the frame
- id: tombol abu-abu di bawah pertanyaan huruf balok; kenop melompat, tombol menyala, warna utama membanjiri layar

## problem

- en: the problem slams in as block words on the dark ground, the mascot peeks from the edge, then a hard cut to colour
- id: masalah menghentak sebagai huruf balok di latar gelap, maskot mengintip dari tepi, lalu potong keras ke warna

## fact

- en: two or three uppercase lines slam from double size, one per beat, one in outline letters; the mascot pops up
- id: dua-tiga baris huruf balok menghentak dari dua kali besar, satu per ketukan, satu berhuruf garis; maskot meletup

## step

- en: a drawn phone rises as a sticker, rows stagger in, a ripple on the fat button, which flips to green with a check
- id: HP gambar naik sebagai stiker, baris berurutan, riak di tombol besar, lalu tombol jadi hijau bercentang

## compare

- en: two sticker cards pop side by side; the weaker one tilts away, the better one gets a sparkle burst
- id: dua kartu stiker meletup berdampingan; yang kalah miring menjauh, yang menang dapat kilau

## number

- en: the number in the display face on a sticker counts up, a 1.15× punch-in, then a sparkle burst
- id: angka berhuruf tebal di stiker dihitung naik, punch-in 1,15×, lalu kilau meletup

## proof

- en: small tiles pop out from the centre behind a counter sticker, then rating stars stick on one by one
- id: ubin kecil meletup dari tengah di belakang stiker angka, lalu bintang menempel satu per satu

## offer

- en: a tilted price tag pops on the accent field, the price counts up, punch-in and sparkles, benefit chips stick on
- id: label harga miring meletup di warna aksen, harga dihitung naik, punch-in dan kilau, chip manfaat menempel

## cta

- en: mascot, the name slammed in two lines, an inverse pill that breathes, contact below; held 2 s
- id: maskot, nama menghentak dua baris, tombol warna kebalikan yang berdenyut, kontak di bawah; diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: on the pop field the closing line slams in, the mascot bobs beside it, one sparkle burst; held 2 s
- id: di warna pop kalimat penutup menghentak, maskot bergoyang di sampingnya, kilau sekali; diam 2 detik

    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
      const NS = "http://www.w3.org/2000/svg";
      // GSAP tweens colours between values, so the toggle reads the brand's main colour from its token.
      const UTAMA = getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue("--utama").trim();

      // Maskot: salinan nyata (bukan <use>) supaya badan dan matanya bisa digerakkan.
      const mascot = document.getElementById("mascot");
      document.querySelectorAll("svg.mascot").forEach((svg) => {
        const copy = mascot.cloneNode(true);
        copy.removeAttribute("id");
        svg.appendChild(copy);
      });

      // Kilau: enam bintang empat sudut di sekitar satu titik.
      function sparks(holderId, cx, cy, radius, color, at) {
        const holder = document.getElementById(holderId);
        for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
          const a = (i / 6) * Math.PI * 2 + 0.3;
          const svg = document.createElementNS(NS, "svg");
          svg.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 90 90");
          svg.setAttribute("class", "spark");
          svg.style.left = cx + Math.cos(a) * radius + "px";
          svg.style.top = cy + Math.sin(a) * radius + "px";
          const use = document.createElementNS(NS, "use");
          use.setAttribute("href", "#sp");
          use.style.fill = i % 2 ? "var(--kertas)" : color;
          use.style.stroke = "var(--tinta)";
          use.style.strokeWidth = "5px";
          svg.appendChild(use);
          holder.appendChild(svg);
          const s = i % 2 ? 0.6 : 1;
          tl.fromTo(svg, { scale: 0, rotation: -90 }, { scale: s, rotation: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: "back.out(3)" }, at + i * 0.03)
            .to(svg, { scale: 0, duration: 0.25, ease: "power2.in" }, at + 0.75 + i * 0.03);
        }
      }
      // Potong keras: adegan lama hilang, adegan baru langsung tampil.
      function cut(from, to, at) {
        tl.set(from, { visibility: "hidden" }, at).set(to, { visibility: "visible" }, at);
      }
      // Kamera: dorong pelan dan linear sepanjang adegan.
      function drift(cam, at, dur, to = 1.05) {
        tl.fromTo(cam, { scale: 1 }, { scale: to, duration: dur, ease: "none" }, at);
      }
      // Maskot: napas naik-turun + kedip.
      function alive(id, at, dur) {
        const body = `#${id} .mb`;
        tl.fromTo(body, { y: 0 }, { y: -18, duration: 0.45, ease: "sine.inOut", yoyo: true, repeat: Math.max(0, Math.floor(dur / 0.45) - 1) }, at);
        tl.to(`#${id} .eyes`, { scaleY: 0.1, transformOrigin: "50% 60%", duration: 0.07, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: "none" }, at + dur * 0.55);
      }

      // 1. Hook (0–1.8): judul membanting, tombol abu-abu dinyalakan, warna membanjiri layar.
      drift("#cam1", 0, 1.8, 1.04);
      tl.from("#hook .w", { scale: 1.9, opacity: 0, duration: 0.28, ease: "circ.out", stagger: 0.22 }, 0.05)
        .from("#toggle", { y: 80, opacity: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: "back.out(2)" }, 0.4)
        .from("#hint", { y: 30, opacity: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: "power2.out" }, 0.55)
        .to("#knob", { x: 300, duration: 0.45, ease: "elastic.out(1, 0.5)" }, 1.0)
        .to("#toggle", { backgroundColor: UTAMA, duration: 0.15, ease: "none" }, 1.02)
        .fromTo("#flood", { scale: 0 }, { scale: 32, duration: 0.55, ease: "power2.in" }, 1.25);

      // 2. Janji (1.8–4.3): kata membanting satu per satu, maskot meletup dari bawah.
      cut("#s1", "#s2", 1.8);
      drift("#cam2", 1.8, 2.5, 1.05);
      tl.from("#vow .w", { scale: 2.2, opacity: 0, duration: 0.26, ease: "circ.out", stagger: 0.3 }, 1.85)

        .from("#s2 .bubble", { scale: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: "back.out(3)", stagger: 0.06 }, 2.75);
      alive("m2", 3.1, 1.2);
      sparks("sp2", 1540, 540, 310, "var(--aksen)", 2.95);

      // 3. HP (4.3–7.3): kartu HP naik, baris pesanan berurutan, tombol diketuk, maskot mengintip.

      tl.from("#t3", { scale: 1.8, opacity: 0, duration: 0.26, ease: "circ.out" }, 4.32)
        .from("#phone", { yPercent: 40, rotation: 6, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "back.out(1.6)" }, 4.4)
        .from("#phone .row", { x: -60, opacity: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: "power2.out", stagger: 0.12 }, 4.75)
        .from("#phone .total", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.25 }, 5.15)
        .fromTo("#ripple", { scale: 0.2, opacity: 1 }, { scale: 3, opacity: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: "power2.out" }, 5.6)

        .from("#done", { scale: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: "back.out(2.5)" }, 5.7)
        .from("#m3", { x: 400, rotation: 25, duration: 0.45, ease: "back.out(1.8)" }, 5.9)
        .from("#say", { scale: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: "back.out(2)" }, 6.25);
      tl.set("#ripple", { opacity: 0 }, 4.3);
      alive("m3", 6.3, 1.0);

      // 4. Harga (7.3–9.9): label harga meletup miring, angka dihitung naik, punch-in, chip menempel.
      cut("#s3", "#s4", 7.3);
      tl.from("#cuma", { y: 40, opacity: 0, duration: 0.25, ease: "power2.out" }, 7.32)
        .fromTo("#tag", { scale: 0, rotation: -25 }, { scale: 1, rotation: -4, duration: 0.45, ease: "back.out(2)" }, 7.4);
      const price = { v: 0 };
      const priceEl = document.getElementById("price");
      tl.to(price, { v: 7000, duration: 0.8, ease: "power2.out",
        onUpdate: () => { const t = "Rp" + (Math.round(price.v / 100) * 100).toLocaleString("id-ID"); if (priceEl.textContent !== t) priceEl.textContent = t; } }, 7.6);
      tl.fromTo("#cam4", { scale: 1 }, { scale: 1.14, duration: 0.3, ease: "circ.out" }, 8.4)
        .to("#cam4", { scale: 1.0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.inOut" }, 8.75);
      // Chip menempel miring (kemiringan akhirnya di sini, bukan di CSS).
      [["#c1", 5], ["#c2", -5], ["#c3", 3]].forEach(([chip, tilt], i) => {
        tl.fromTo(chip, { scale: 0, rotation: tilt - 30 }, { scale: 1, rotation: tilt, duration: 0.35, ease: "back.out(2.6)" }, 8.8 + i * 0.18);

      sparks("sp4", 540, 550, 470, "var(--utama)", 8.4);

      const mosaic = document.getElementById("mosaic");
      for (let i = 0; i < 77; i++) mosaic.appendChild(document.createElement("i"));
      const stars = document.getElementById("stars");
      for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        const s = document.createElementNS(NS, "svg");
        s.setAttribute("viewBox", "0 0 96 96");
        s.innerHTML = '<use href="#star" class="bintang" />';
        stars.appendChild(s);
      }
      tl.fromTo("#mosaic", { scale: 1.6 }, { scale: 1, duration: 1.1, ease: "power1.out" }, 9.9);
      tl.from("#mosaic i", { scale: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: "back.out(2)", stagger: { each: 0.008, from: "center", grid: "auto" } }, 9.92)
        .from("#proof", { scale: 0.3, rotation: 8, opacity: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: "back.out(1.8)" }, 10.05);
      const num = { v: 0 };
      const numEl = document.getElementById("num");
      tl.to(num, { v: 1250, duration: 0.9, ease: "power2.out",

      tl.from("#stars svg", { scale: 0, rotation: -60, duration: 0.3, ease: "back.out(3)", stagger: 0.1 }, 10.9);

      // 6. Penutup (12.1–15): maskot, nama membanting, tombol Chat berdenyut, diam supaya terbaca.

        .from("#info", { y: 30, opacity: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: "power2.out" }, 13.15)
        .to("#cta", { scale: 1.06, duration: 0.35, ease: "sine.inOut", yoyo: true, repeat: 3 }, 13.5);
